comparison: Both address the computational model (C72, C74-C77). OpenEval finds the model SUPPORTED as appropriate for quantitative predictions. Peer reviewers show UNCERTAIN evaluation: Reviewer 3 challenges the necessity of the 3D model, arguing a 1D model would suffice, while Reviewers 1-2 accept the model choice and parameters as reasonable.

Both address developmental modularity claims (C7, C57, C64-C66, C70, C80). Both evaluations are SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes bidirectional independence supports modularity but mentions coupling delay results suggest constraints. Peer reviewers fully accept the modularity conclusion, with all three reviewers and the editor endorsing it as a conceptual advance.

Both address coupling delay findings (C51, C55, C60). Both are SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes this is a significant finding but raises questions about model accuracy. Peer reviewers accept the findings, with Reviewer 1 having explicitly requested this analysis and implicitly accepting the results.

Both address cell division and mitosis claims (C93-C95, C97-C98). Both are SUPPORTED. OpenEval finds the biological context well-established with appropriate citations. Peer reviewers accept the mitosis findings without questioning the cited biological parameters.

Both address evolutionary implications (C67-C68, C11). OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN, noting these are speculative predictions with cautious language but lacking direct evidence. Peer reviewers rate SUPPORTED, with the editor and all reviewers explicitly endorsing the evolutionary interpretation as a conceptual advance.

Both address cell ingression and motility robustness (C31-C36). Both are SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes data support conclusions but biological significance of 'minor' decreases is not quantified. Peer reviewers fully accept the modeling results, with all three reviewers agreeing the manuscript is clearly written and conclusions are supported.

Both address compaction-extension effects (C42-C43, C92). Both are SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes maintained clock dynamics with acknowledged limitations at terminal stages. Peer reviewers accept the findings as part of the model achieving its goal, with no challenges to the core results.

Both address main computational findings on robustness and PSM parameters (C4, C5, C56, C69, C79). Both are SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes robustness demonstrated with caveats regarding cell division and coupling delay. Peer reviewers accept conclusions as stemming directly from modeling results, though Reviewer 3 requests more complete parameter exploration.

Both address cell division spatial restriction findings (C47, C78). Both are SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes biological relevance depends on whether spatial restriction occurs in vivo. Peer reviewers accept the mitosis findings without questioning this aspect.

Both address parameter exploration for motility (C35-C36). Both are SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes lack of trends supports independent evolution but is limited to tested parameter ranges. Peer reviewers accept the modeling results showing robustness to motility.

OpenEval addresses prior work on morphogenetic processes and clock dynamics (C24-C28), rated SUPPORTED. Peer result R8 addresses assumptions about clock gene expression at ingression (C27, C83), rated UNCERTAIN. Reviewer 2 questions whether the assumption about non-expressing ingressing cells is outdated for zebrafish.

Both address coupling delay mechanisms (C5, C61). OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN, noting C61 is cited but C62 about developmental drift is speculative. Peer reviewers rate the coupling delay findings (including C61) as SUPPORTED, accepting the analysis that was requested by Reviewer 1.

Both address cell ingression and clock gene expression (C83). OpenEval rates SUPPORTED, noting established facts with sound logic. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, with Reviewer 2 questioning whether the assumption about non-expressing cells at ingression is accurate for zebrafish.

Both address compaction-extension mechanisms (C92). OpenEval rates SUPPORTED with established observations and sound mechanistic reasoning (C86-C92). Peer reviewers rate SUPPORTED, accepting the findings without challenge as part of the model's evaluation of morphogenetic robustness.

OpenEval addresses biological context and knowledge gap (C1, C2, C8) as SUPPORTED, representing established knowledge cited from Richardson et al., 1998. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for these background claims.

OpenEval addresses established mechanistic understanding of somitogenesis and PSM elongation (C3, C9-C10, C12-C20) as SUPPORTED with multiple citations. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for these background claims.

OpenEval addresses central hypothesis and developmental modularity definition (C11, C21-C23) as SUPPORTED, appropriately framed as speculation based on prior observations. Peer result R7 includes C11 but focuses on evolutionary implications rather than hypothesis framing.
